visuals.heading: Cost Difference Nobody Puts on the Brochure

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: A serious two-year JEE coaching commitment in a hub city like Kota can run ₹4-12 lakh once hostel, food, and study material are added on top of tuition, with structured online coaching cutting that to roughly ₹1.5-4 lakh. Dropout rates in full-time offline coaching batches sit near 20%, and studies on Kota's coaching ecosystem have flagged serious stress and mental-health concerns among aspirants, this is a real cost, not only a financial one.

figures.source: CUET preparation costs a fraction of that. The exam fee itself is ₹1000 per subject for general-category candidates, and because the syllabus mirrors your Class 12 boards, most students can prepare using their existing study plan plus NCERT revision, with coaching as an optional add-on rather than an assumed requirement.
